item: N687 v3 Screen results: permutation test
style_reference: Figure S7R,S of the spaCR/EAF1 preprint (within-plate Freedman-Lane permutation volcanoes, x partial Pearson r, y -log10 BH-adjusted empirical P, dashed BH q = 0.05, dotted effect cutoff, points coloured by predicted compartment)

figures.alt: Gene-level permutation volcano: partial correlation against minus log10 BH-adjusted empirical P, coloured by compartment; GRA14, EAF1 and SAG1 named.
figures.caption: Gene level: 414 genes tested (each gene's summed guide fractions). 4 reach BH q < 0.05 (SAG1 (TGGT1_233460) r = -0.317, P = 5.0×10^-7, q = 1.0×10^-4; GRA14 (TGGT1_239740) r = +0.435, P = 5.0×10^-7, q = 1.0×10^-4; EAF1 (TGGT1_225160) r = +0.240, P = 1.0×10^-6, q = 1.4×10^-4; GRA12B (TGGT1_275860) r = +0.157, P = 1.7×10^-4, q = 1.7×10^-2); 3 also pass the effect cut: SAG1 (TGGT1_233460), GRA14 (TGGT1_239740), EAF1 (TGGT1_225160). 2 genes sit at the P floor (no permutation as extreme). 2,000,000 within-plate Freedman-Lane permutations, seed 0; smallest attainable P = 1/(B+1) = 5.0×10^-7. MaxViT per-cell scores averaged per well, 1,290 wells on 4 plates, partial Pearson r given plate, row and column. Dashed line BH q = 0.05; dotted lines the spaCR effect cut (3x std of 29 controls = 0.221).

figures.alt: Guide-level permutation volcano: partial correlation against minus log10 BH-adjusted empirical P, coloured by compartment; GRA14 guides 1 and 3, SAG1 guide 4 and EAF1 guide 2 named.
figures.caption: Guide level: 953 guides tested. 3 reach BH q < 0.05 (SAG1 guide 4 r = -0.317, P = 5.0×10^-7, q = 1.6×10^-4; GRA14 guide 1 r = +0.397, P = 5.0×10^-7, q = 1.6×10^-4; GRA14 guide 3 r = +0.263, P = 5.0×10^-7, q = 1.6×10^-4); 3 pass the effect cut. 3 guides sit at the P floor. 2,000,000 within-plate Freedman-Lane permutations, seed 0; smallest attainable P = 1/(B+1) = 5.0×10^-7. MaxViT per-cell scores averaged per well, 1,290 wells on 4 plates, partial Pearson r given plate, row and column. Dashed line BH q = 0.05; dotted lines the spaCR effect cut (3x std of 29 controls = 0.221).

figures.alt: Three histograms of the permutation null of the partial correlation, for GRA14, EAF1 and SAG1, each with the observed value far outside the null.
figures.caption: Permutation null of the gene-level partial correlation for GRA14, EAF1 and SAG1 (2,000,000 draws, seed 0; log count scale). Solid line: observed r; dashed: -r (the test is two-sided on |r|). b = permutations at least as extreme; P = (b+1)/(B+1). GRA14 r = +0.435, b = 0; EAF1 r = +0.240, b = 1; SAG1 r = -0.317, b = 0. The draws were regenerated from spaCR's own projection and seeded generator, and their exceedance counts equal the counts spaCR reported for these genes.
